shots.purpose: Establish institutional gravity, precision, and architectural scale in deep dark space.
shots.positive_prompt: Minimalist luxury 3D architectural motion design shot, sparse dark obsidian (#070D20) architectural coordinate grid emerging gradually through a narrow vertical cobalt blue (#245BFF) volumetric light slit in a deep midnight navy (#101F45) void. Slow controlled 35mm dolly push-in at 0.4m/s, extreme negative space on the left third, subtle optical refraction, razor-sharp geometric lines, physically based rendering, restrained international design studio aesthetic.
shots.negative_prompt: accidental lettering, text, watermark, logos, glowing globes, puzzle pieces, sunset pink, warm red, stock skyline, chaotic particles, camera shake, lens flare
shots.deterministic_post: Overlay hair-line Swiss coordinate grid (16.0544° N, 108.2022° E) in DaVinci Resolve / Motion Canvas.

shots.purpose: Reveal the connection between Real Estate (modular volumes) and Technology (luminous data filaments).

Controlled 18-degree lateral camera orbit with subtle parallax, measured and precise mechanical motion.
